subject: Helio AI pilot: readiness, success criteria, and GPU scheduling
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@heliosai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@heliosai.com>, infra@heliosai.com
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + POC requirements

Thanks Marcus — great call earlier. I attached a short worksheet (helios_poc_requirements.xlsx) that summarizes the workloads we want to run during the pilot: multi-user chat at variable prompt lengths, a reranking step for search relevance, and an embedding cache warmup. High-level asks from our side:

- Ability to validate latency and token-cost under our typical traffic (50-150 concurrent sessions).
- A way to run deterministic evaluation sets (we have ~3k golden prompts).
- Isolation: data should not be used for other customers; audit logs are required.

Can you confirm the sizing you recommend and a rough timeline for starting? Also, what are the next steps on your side to get the dedicated pilot environment set up?

Thanks,
Samir
VP Product, Helio AI

Attachment: helios_poc_requirements.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@heliosai.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2027 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + POC requirements

Samir — thanks for sending the worksheet and for the clear priorities. Recap below plus a concrete plan so Helio can review with infra and procurement.

POC success criteria (suggested):
- Functional: model outputs must meet Helio’s evaluation thresholds on the 3k golden prompts (precision@k >= 0.78 for reranking; embedding cosine recall >= 0.85).
- Performance: 95th-percentile latency for chat generation < 120 ms for typical prompts (up to 512 tokens), and end-to-end rerank pipeline p95 < 180 ms.
- Cost/ops: sustained inference unit cost within the target range we discussed (we'll surface a per-token estimate in the pilot MOP).
- Reliability: <1% error rate during a 72-hour steady-state run; automatic fallback to a smaller variant if capacity is exhausted.

Capacity recommendation (initial pilot):
- Reserved pool: 4 x A100-80GB (NVIDIA A100 equivalence) as the baseline.
- Autoscaling: scale up to 8 GPUs for bursts (policy: CPU/GPU utilization over 70% for 2 consecutive minutes triggers scale-up; scale-down with 10-minute cooldown).
- Burst behavior: allow short bursts to 8 GPUs for up to 30 minutes without extra approval; multi-hour bursts require approval and capacity reservations.
- Caching: prefix + KV cache enabled for session warmup to reduce cold-start token cost; we will provide cache-warmup scripts.

Timeline and ownership:
- Week 0 (this week): sign mutual NDA and confirm MOP/attachments. Owner: Marcus (sales).
- Week 1: pilot environment provisioning + network placement (VPC peering / whitelist). Owner: Jasmine (solutions engineer).
- Week 2: model onboarding, quantization profile, and initial test run. Owner: Laura (customer success).
- Week 3: 72-hour steady-state run, run evaluation harness against golden prompts. Owner: Helio infra + Redwood (joint).

Attachments: I attached a short MOP (redwood_pilot_mop.pdf) with the exact test commands, scripts for warmup, and our template acceptance criteria.

Next steps for Helio: confirm the success criteria above, share any additional compliance checkpoints you need (e.g., SOC2 evidence), and nominate the infra contact who will accept peering requests. Once we have that, we’ll provision the reserved pool and schedule provisioning.

If useful, I can propose two kickoff slots next week (Tue 10–11am PT or Wed 1–2pm PT).

—Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachment: redwood_pilot_mop.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Priya Rao <priya@heliosai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@heliosai.com>, Helio Infra <infra@heliosai.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2027 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + POC requirements

Thanks Marcus — this is very helpful and aligns with our expectations. A few clarifications from infra and procurement: 

1) Dataset handling: for the 3k golden prompts we want to ensure the data is treated as customer-owned and that the logs show no cross-tenant exposure. Can you point to where in the MOP you document audit log retention and controls?

2) Canary strategy: we'd like a canary rollout for the new model variant (10% of traffic for the first 24 hours) before a full steady-state run. Is that supported in the pilot environment?

3) Sizing / pricing: your suggested 4→8 A100 baseline sounds reasonable. Can you provide a ballpark for monthly reserved cost and an incremental hourly burst rate so procurement can budget?

4) Network: infra will share the egress restrictions and must have the peering/whitelist step completed before provisioning.

We can confirm the kickoff slot on Tue 10–11am PT if that works for the Redwood team.

Thanks,
Priya
Director, Engineering Operations, Helio AI

Date: Sat, 04 Dec 2027 11:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + POC requirements — internal owners + kickoff

Looping you all in to confirm owners and the proposed kickoff. Short notes and action items: 

- Jasmine: you own Week 1 provisioning (VPC peering, CIDR allowlist, KMS key exchange). Please request the infra contact from Priya and start the system-design checklist from the MOP.
- Laura: you own Week 2 onboarding and will run the evaluation harness; coordinate with Helio for the golden prompts format (CSV or NDJSON).
- Aditya: please prepare a quick cost estimate (monthly reserved + burst hourly) and draft a short procurement note we can share with Priya. Include optional line items for increased burst hours.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 07 Dec 2027, 10:00–11:00 PT (I suggested Tue 10–11 earlier; confirmed with Helio). Agenda: intros, network checklist, pilot MOP review, ownership + timeline, Q&A (30 min). I'll send a calendar invite once owners confirm.

Quick checklist before kickoff:
- NDA signed / MOP acknowledged (Marcus)
- Infra contact for peering (Priya)
- Golden prompts & acceptance CSV (Helio)
- Cost estimate for procurement (Aditya)

If you want, I can spin up a short shared doc with the runbook and acceptance criteria tomorrow.

—Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
